text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm worn out! I ran bunches and
bunches.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I really tried my best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, do you think I've gotten better at
this?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I think I have. I've been trying so hard,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's true! Okay, I'm gonna run
hard in the
next race!
choice_data_list: Let's find out in the race!

text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara has a very fulfilling summer
camp.
